messages:
Ava (marketing): Heads up — noticed ~0.7% of inbound leads marked 'enrichment:soft_fail' in last 24h. Mostly HubSpot webhook 429/timeout. Should we auto-ticket and route to ops so leads don't fall into dead-letter? cc @Priya
Priya (ops): Yeah saw noisy alerts this morning. 3 spikes between 01:10-02:00 PST. If we can create a ticket for any lead where enrichment.failed_count >=1 and hubspot.response_code >= 500/429, ops can triage faster.
Daniel (growth): Agree. For priority leads (company.size > 50 || lead.score >= 75) we should also notify sales-eng. Otherwise ticket queue is noisy. :loud_sound: 
Chris (sales-eng): +1. How's enrichment retried today? If it's retriable we shouldn't create SLA tickets immediately. Need a short cooldown.
Ava (marketing): Current system retries twice with exponential backoff (30s, 2m) then marks soft_fail. Proposal: change policy -> create ticket after 3rd failed enrichment, but only if last_attempt < 24h and lead.source != 'partner_api'. Also add 'retry-window' tag so SRE can correlate.
Priya (ops): Sounds good. Quick Zapier prototype to create ticket in Ops queue:
```
Trigger: HubSpot property change -> enrichment_status == 'soft_fail'
Filter: enrichment.retry_count >= 3 AND source != 'partner_api'
Action: Create ticket in Zendesk with tags: 'enrich-softfail', 'retry-window'
```
Daniel (growth): Might be better to handle at ingest layer (Zapier adds latency). Can we use HubSpot workflows + webhook to internal ticket API? Simpler and faster.
Ava (marketing): Yes — sample HubSpot filter for a view:
```
Property: enrichment_status is any of 'soft_fail'
AND enrichment_retry_count >= 3
AND (hs_lead_score >= 60 OR company_size >= 50)
```
Priya (ops): I'll draft the ticket template. Fields: lead_id, email, enrichment_logs (paste), last_response_code, attempt_timestamps, original_payload_snapshot. Assign to 'inbound-enrich' queue.
ops-bot: alert: enrichment.soft_fail rate increased by 420% vs baseline in last 24h — incident created (INC-2026-174). link: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-174
Chris (sales-eng): Can we add a 'no-auto-ticket' opt-out for leads from known partners? Otherwise will create noise.
Ava (marketing): Adding rule: if hubspot.owner_team == 'partner-handovers' or lead.tags contains 'no_ticket' then skip.
Priya (ops): Action items:
- Priya: add HubSpot workflow + webhook -> internal ticket API (ETA 48h)
- Daniel: add sales notify rule for high-score leads (ETA 24h)
- SRE: expose enrichment logs link in ticket payload (ping @SRE)
- Ava: update inbound runbook with fallback policy
Ava (marketing): cool. I'll open a short RFC and ping legal if we need PII rules for draft tickets. :white_check_mark:
Daniel (growth): thumbs. Let's reconvene after initial rollout.
